pins.title: Our Jungle House Establishes Its Khao Sok Treehouse Retreat Around 1985
pins.description: Our Jungle House is a riverside treehouse and bungalow lodge in Khlong Sok, Thailand. Its approximate founding year is reported as 1985; the exact opening date is unverified.
pins.dateConfidenceReasoning: Year-level estimate only: ThailandAddict describes the lodge as going back to around 1985. January 1 is a placeholder for that approximate year, not a verified opening day. The operator confirms the property and founder but does not give an opening year.
pins.longFormSummary:
• Our Jungle House offers treehouses and bungalows beside the Sok River in Khlong Sok. The operator describes natural ventilation, private bathrooms, and Wi-Fi in shared areas rather than rooms.
  • A travel guide places its origins around 1985. The exact opening date remains unverified; the pin uses year-level precision.
  • The operator names Dick Sandler as founder and describes rainforest protection and community education among its aims.

pins.title: The Birdhouse El Nido Opens in September 2016; Later Reported Closed
pins.description: The Birdhouse began as a glamping retreat above Maremegmeg Beach in El Nido in September 2016. A firsthand travel account was updated January 6, 2024 to report permanent closure; no reopening was verified.
pins.dateConfidenceReasoning: Month-level opening evidence: Illustrado July 23, 2018 says the property opened in September 2016. September 1 is a month placeholder, not the verified day. Closure was reported by January 6, 2024; the actual closure date is not established.
pins.longFormSummary:
• Illustrado’s July 2018 founder profile dates the opening of The Birdhouse El Nido to September 2016 and identifies Camille and Mark-Anthony Villaflor as founders.
  • The historical retreat occupied a ridge above Maremegmeg Beach, with tent accommodation and views toward Bacuit Bay. A firsthand account describes steep bamboo access steps and private-bathroom tents.
  • That account carries a January 6, 2024 update reporting permanent closure. This pin records the historical opening and does not advertise current bookings; no reopening was verified in this repair.

pins.title: Riad Yasmine Opens in Marrakech in 2002
pins.description: Riad Yasmine is an eight-room guesthouse in the Marrakech medina. Its operator dates its opening to 2002 and distinguishes that from Alice and Gabriel taking over management in November 2015.
pins.dateConfidenceReasoning: Year-level precision: the operator’s French about page explicitly says “ouverture en 2002”. January 1 is a year placeholder, not an evidenced opening day. November 2015 was a management takeover, not the original opening.
pins.longFormSummary:
• The operator dates Riad Yasmine’s opening to 2002 and says Alice and Gabriel took over management in November 2015.
  • The guesthouse is at 209 rue Ank Jemel, Bab Taghzout, in the Marrakech medina. Its courtyard pool, rooms and rooftop are presented on the property’s official pages.
  • An interview with Alice describes taking over the existing family guesthouse and progressively redecorating its rooms, patio and rooftop. The adjoining Le Petit Yasmine is a separate property.
